-- Bell, Book, and Candle (2025) - romantic comedy, witchcraft
INSERT INTO projectTags (projectId, tagId)
SELECT p.id, t.id FROM projects p CROSS JOIN tags t
WHERE p.title = 'Bell, Book, and Candle' AND t.name IN ('Comedy', '2025', 'Romantic Comedy', 'Summer Stock', 'Witchcraft', 'Contemporary')
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE projectId = projectId;

-- All's Well That Ends Well (2025) - Shakespeare comedy
INSERT INTO projectTags (projectId, tagId)
SELECT p.id, t.id FROM projects p CROSS JOIN tags t
WHERE p.title = 'All''s Well That Ends Well' AND t.name IN ('Shakespeare', '2025', 'Comedy', 'Theatre Festival', 'Irvine', 'Romantic Comedy')
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE projectId = projectId;
